rules: NO generic gradients. NO rainbow colors.
Every section must feel like a different dimension of the same cosmic universe.
Always include data-testid on interactive elements.

hero.layout: Full viewport height, flex center, relative positioning for particles.

typography.jumbotron_text: text-[12vw] md:text-[8vw] font-bold uppercase leading-none tracking-tighter text-[#f0f0ff] font-['Oswald']
typography.japanese_tagline: absolute top-1/4 right-10 text-2xl md:text-4xl writing-vertical-rl font-['Shippori_Mincho'] text-[#f0f0ff]/50 mix-blend-difference

elements.particles: Use tsparticles or pure CSS box-shadow for a minimal starry background.
elements.ctas: Two minimalist buttons at the bottom left. 'See My Work' & 'Download CV'. Use 1px border border-[#f0f0ff]/20 hover:bg-[#f0f0ff] hover:text-[#0a0a0f] transition-all duration-300.

hero.animation: Parallax scroll effect on the main text (moves slower than background). Reveal animation on load using Framer Motion.

about.layout: Grid 1 column mobile, 2 columns desktop. Generous padding (py-32 px-8).

left_col.treatment: Use as background for the left column with mix-blend-screen or overlay with abstract SVG orbital lines (stroke-[#0d9488]/30).

right_col.description: Draggable physics chips for bio info.
right_col.label: 私について (Japanese label, top right, font-serif text-[#0d9488])
right_col.chip_style: cursor-grab active:cursor-grabbing px-6 py-3 rounded-full backdrop-blur-md bg-white/5 border border-white/10 text-lg font-['Outfit'] inline-block m-2
right_col.implementation: Use framer-motion <motion.div drag dragConstraints={parentRef}> for the physics feel.

projects.center_element: A central glowing black hole. width/height 150px rounded-full bg-black shadow-[0_0_100px_40px_rgba(124,58,237,0.3)]. No generic gradients inside, just raw box-shadow outer glow.

orbiting_cards.style: absolute w-64 h-40 flex items-center justify-center p-4 text-center backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0a0a0f]/60 border border-[#7c3aed]/20 rounded-lg shadow-lg text-sm font-['Outfit']
orbiting_cards.animation: Container wrapper spins 360deg infinitely (duration ~30s). Individual cards counter-spin -360deg so text remains readable (upright). Use Framer Motion.

skills.layout: Full width relative canvas, min-h-[80vh]. py-20.

constellations.visual_treatment: Use inline SVG spanning the container. <circle> for stars (fill-[#fbbf24]), <line> for connections (stroke-[#f0f0ff]/20). Use Framer motion pathLength for drawing the lines on scroll into view.
constellations.interaction: Hovering a star group increases opacity of its label and makes the star glow (shadow-[0_0_15px_#fbbf24]).

awards.layout: Perspective container to give 3D depth. Flex center py-32.

newspaper.title: THE COSMIC GAZETTE
newspaper.style: bg-cover bg-center text-[#0a0a0f] p-8 max-w-2xl w-full aspect-[3/4] shadow-[20px_20px_0px_#fbbf24]
newspaper.animation: Flippable 3D effect. Use CSS transform: rotateY() and perspective: 1000px on the parent. Or simple framer-motion 3D rotation on hover/scroll.

contact.layout: Relative min-h-screen flex flex-col items-center justify-center overflow-hidden pt-32 pb-10

whale_transition.description: Cosmic whale animation that 'swallows' the screen to reveal the form.
whale_transition.animation: Animate the whale image rising from the bottom edge using Framer Motion on scroll, slightly scaling up to cover the background behind the form.

form.style: z-10 w-full max-w-md bg-[#0a0a0f]/80 backdrop-blur-md p-8 border border-[#0d9488]/30
form.inputs: Minimalist. bg-transparent border-b border-[#0d9488]/50 focus:border-[#0d9488] focus:outline-none py-2 text-[#f0f0ff]
form.button: mt-8 border border-[#0d9488] px-6 py-2 hover:bg-[#0d9488] hover:text-[#0a0a0f] transition-colors uppercase font-['Oswald'] tracking-wider

footer.japanese_closer: 一緒に作りましょう。 (Let's build together - Font Serif, large, faint in the background)
footer.style: mt-20 z-10 text-center flex flex-col gap-4 text-sm text-[#f0f0ff]/60

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Framer Motion extensively for dragging, orbiting, and scroll-triggered reveals.
Do NOT use generic gradients anywhere. Use pure solid colors with low opacity borders or heavy box-shadows for glows.
For typography, import Oswald, Shippori Mincho, and Outfit from Google Fonts.
Ensure the Projects section uses absolute positioning with mathematical rotation (container spins + card spins inversely) to create the orbit effect.
For the Skills section, manually plot SVG <circle> and <line> coordinates relative to a viewbox.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, form inputs, and major section containers.
